title: Antoin Gibson releases an anthem of truth with "Diss Qualification"
htmlContent: London's very own Antoin Gibson is back with vengeance with their new single, "Diss Qualification". The track was released via Circum Sŏnus, and it's a blend of rap and political hip-hop. This track is a manifesto, complete with bars and beats, and a dose of bravado. Gibson's delivery slices through with lethal precision, scorning hypocrisy, bureaucracy, and the corrupt power structures that stifle progress. Every line feels labored over, radiating both frustration and clarity, the sound of an artist who will not be quieted or sanitized. https://open.spotify.com/track/6NbYw3GITxBrerEY61hy7z "Diss Qualification" lives in tension, pulsing through the production with a dark, metallic energy, as tight basslines grind against relentless percussion and eerie atmospherics. Gibson's flow rides the beat with an effortless authority, a perfect combination of raw aggression and razor-sharp intellect. But beyond its provocative surface is a more earnest statement, as "Diss Qualification" is about repossessing the right to speak truth in a world drunk on distraction. Gibson is the master of transforming criticism into art and protest into poetry. In the case of Circum Sŏnus, Antoin Gibson is clearly continuing to forge ahead as an unconventional thinker who shuns the formula. "Diss Qualification" is a challenge, a wake-up call, and a reminder that real rap still has something potent to say. Follow Antoin Gibson on Instagram
